route: Private medical insurance for study (Immigration Service Delivery)

evidence.excerpt: All non-EEA students are required to have private medical insurance when coming to and residing in Ireland for the purpose of study.

evidence.locator: Private Medical Insurance, where travel insurance may suffice
evidence.excerpt: The insurance coverage covers the student at a minimum of EUR 25,000 for accident and EUR 25,000 for disease

evidence.locator: Private Medical Insurance, where travel insurance may suffice
evidence.excerpt: The insurance covers the student for one full year or where the student is staying in Ireland for less than one year for the entirety of their stay
